rendition_note: Commons serves only the fixed bucket widths listed above and snaps a request UP to the next one; there is no 600px rendition. A request for 600 therefore lands on the 960 bucket, or returns the unmodified original when the source is narrower than 960. Every width_fetched below is MEASURED FROM THE BYTES ON DISK -- the Commons API's imageinfo.thumbwidth echoes the requested width and cannot be trusted.
sharealike_note: OPEN DECISION 2 decided 2026-07-25 -> option (a): no fixed derivative work is created. Assets are Commons-generated mechanical resizes of the unmodified source at the same licence; the PlayerMark treatment is CSS at render time. Where Commons declined to generate a thumbnail (sources narrower than the 960 bucket) the unmodified original is stored, recorded as rendition=commons_original.
attribution_note: Attribution is the default, not the exception. Credits must render VISIBLY -- hiding them behind a hover or an info affordance is a licence violation for every asset with attribution_required=true.

killswitch_detail.scope: PlayerMark assets are NOT covered by TEAM_LOGOS_ENABLED. A Commons takedown or relicence is a per-asset action: drop the file, set the row's status, and the renderer falls back to the designed card via has_usable_image / the width branch.
